purpose: Electron desktop cockpit for driving and observing Claude Code CLI sessions across projects, with a scheduler that turns approved Epics into autonomously-executed PRDs.
what: The app centers on a **TAB → EPIC → SESSION → PRD** hierarchy: a Terminal tab is anchored to one project cwd, and each Epic (`PromptSession`) is a tagged claude session with a single lifecycle field (`proposed` → `active` → `completed`). Recent work hardened this model — `1f4e6e6` locked Epic creation to explicit human intent, `993f9d0` closed three lifecycle gaps, and `b141ce6` added a structured `EpicSource` field.

The **Scheduler** (`src/main/scheduler.cjs`, `lib/queueStore.cjs`) runs PRDs per-project from `session-manager-operations/scheduler/epics/<epic-id>/prds/` as `claude -p` jobs, gated on Epic approval (`3577195`), with boot reconciliation, a dead-process reaper, and a definition-of-done drain hook. `1ade7e3`/`4517458` fixed `dependsOn` satisfaction semantics.

A **Two-Face LeftNav** framework (`ec9be06`) now splits navigation into Home-only (global session-manager config) vs Project-only (per-tab) destinations, derived from focused panel rather than tab selection (`d5cbcb1`) — heavily regression-tested across nav items (Skills, MCP, Hooks, Settings, Permissions, History, Scheduler, Memory, Voice, Remote, RepoViz, Search) in the latest ~30 commits.

Chat gained a **Prompt Queue** panel (`1cf0b2b`) and inline **MCP consent** handling — `InlineConsentTerminal`, a small embedded PTY widget wired into the consent-notice card (`ebb4f3b`) with a one-click Retry (`8ce6cb8`), addressing the completed 'Granting Consent via Chat' Epic.

scope.text: No 'general' OWNERS namespace exists or is needed; architecture/, design-mocks/, HUMAN_LEARN/, reviews/ stay outside single-writer law as skill-authored artifacts, not app runtime state.
Scheduler reframed as a browser over TAB → EPIC → PRD, scoped to the active tab's project by default (v0.39.4).
Epic lifecycle fixed at exactly three states (proposed/active/completed); every Epic is born proposed, only markCompleted archives it.
Epic creation locked down to explicit human intent only — no implicit/automatic Epic minting.
Two-Face LeftNav: NavFace type + per-item face registry, derived from focused panel not tab selection.
Prompt Queue default behavior is chat-first — PRDs only created explicitly/exceptionally, agent decides based on responses.

conventions: Tab ID = claudeSessionId; Chat and Terminal are two views over one session, never two sessionIds.
Single-writer law over `session-manager-operations/<namespace>/` — fail-closed via `opsOwnership.cjs`; new writers/namespaces require deliberate table edits.
zustand stores are isolated islands (config/live/voice/scheduleState/toast) — never cross-subscribe; avoid fresh-value selectors (React #185 blank-app risk), guarded by `npm run lint:selectors`.
Max 3 concurrent `claude -p` jobs machine-wide via session slot pool — do not exceed (OOM risk), though an Epic proposes raising the configurable range to 0–10 default 5.
No backwards-compat shims (single-author project) — rename/refactor directly.
Before adding a new LeftNav destination, check if an existing surface (Terminal/Scheduler) already owns that data instead of duplicating.
